Skill `project-manager`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `query_project_context` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; needs `user_conversation`; adds `project_context_known`.
Tool `review_project_materials` (owner `agent`): via `read`; requires `project_context_known`; adds `resources_reviewed`, `timelines_reviewed`, `dependencies_reviewed`, `risks_reviewed`.
Tool `research_project_context` (owner `agent`): via `web_search`; requires `project_context_known`; adds `external_context_reviewed`.
Tool `update_project_documents` (owner `agent`): via `write`; requires `project_context_known`; adds `documentation_complete`, `charter_defined`, `wbs_defined`, `resource_plan_defined`, `risk_register_maintained`, `communication_plan_defined`, `quality_plan_defined`, `schedule_baseline_defined`, `budget_baseline_defined`, `lessons_learned_captured`.
Tool `prepare_project_report` (owner `agent`): via `write`; requires `project_context_known`; adds `project_health_analyzed`, `bottlenecks_analyzed`, `opportunities_analyzed`, `project_report_prepared`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: all of (`project_context_known`, `resources_reviewed`, `timelines_reviewed`, `dependencies_reviewed`, `risks_reviewed`, `project_health_analyzed`, `bottlenecks_analyzed`, `opportunities_analyzed`, `risk_register_maintained`, `documentation_complete`, `project_report_prepared`).
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `query_project_context`.
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `materials_available`:
      - `agent` uses `review_project_materials`.
    - branch `no_materials_available`: none.
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `external_research_needed`:
      - `agent` uses `research_project_context`.
    - branch `no_external_research_needed`: none.
  - `agent` uses `update_project_documents`.
  - `agent` uses `prepare_project_report`.
